FOREWORD
At the time of the preparation of this Environmental Impact Statement there existed a number of unresolved issues which would affect the ultimate level of the standard and thus, alter the impact of this proposal on the environment. For this reason the Environmental Impact Statement discusses the impacts associated with the range of fuel economy standards under consideration.
The agency has concluded that the appropriate fuel economy standard for non-passenger automobiles in model year 1979 should be 17.2 mpg. In addition the agency has determined to establish a separate standard of 15.8 mpg for four-wheel drive recreational vehicles and to allow manufacturers of these vehicles the option of meeting this standard or including these vehicles in their total non-passenger automobile fleet and meeting the 17.2 standard on a production weighted basis.
The Average Fuel Economy Standard For Non-passenger Automobiles for Model Year 1979 is attached to this statement and presents the resolution of other issues which were outstanding at the time of preparation of this report.
